mapper.select: SELECT * FROM monitored_service ORDER BY sort_no ASC
SELECT * FROM monitored_service WHERE enabled = TRUE AND health_check_url IS NOT NULL AND health_check_url != ''
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO monitored_service (service_name, container_name, health_check_url, sort_no, enabled) VALUES (#{service_name}, #{container_name}, #{health_check_url}, #{sort_no}, COALESCE(#{enabled}, TRUE))
mapper.update: UPDATE monitored_service SET sort_no = #{sort_no} WHERE service_id = #{service_id}
UPDATE monitored_service SET last_status = #{status}, last_checked_at = NOW() WHERE service_id = #{service_id}
